_notes: Handkurerat 2026-08-03 mot cityofbrookings-sd.gov och brookingslibrary.org. Library-timmar bekräftade mot två oberoende källor (Yelp och countyoffice.org), samstämmiga. City Hall/Parks & Rec-timmar från cityofbrookings-sd.gov facility- och directory-sidor. Inga personnamn utom offentliga tjänstemän i officiell roll. SDSU campus-anläggningarna (2026-08-23, se NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW.md 'Brookings Full Audit P3') tillagda för att dela venue-registret med Jackrabbits/university-täckningen -- adresser korsverifierade mot minst två oberoende källor (gojacks.com, Wikipedia, SDSU:s egen sdstate.edu/buildings, Waze) vardera. 23 stadsparker tillagda samma dag via scripts/ingest_brookings_facilities.py (GIS-import, se det skriptets docstring), inte i den här handkuraterade filen. 2026-08-25 (se NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW.md, 'Brookings Venue Registry'): street_address/postal_code/aliases tillagda på de befintliga posterna nedan (matchar nu venue-resolution), plus fyra nya venues (Outdoor Adventure Center, Downtown Main Avenue, Edgebrook Golf Course, Good Roots Farm) -- alla adresser oförändrade mot vad som redan var handverifierat, endast maskinläsbar struktur tillagd. lat/lon geokodade via samma publika Esri World Geocoding Service (geocode.arcgis.com, ingen nyckel) som scripts/ingest_moval_facilities.py redan använder -- alla 10 träffar score >= 98.87 (de flesta exakt 100), inga gissade koordinater. Wooden Legs Brewing Company tillagd samma dag efter att ha stått olöst i venue-resolution-passet (1 förekomst) -- adress/aliaser lämnade direkt av ägaren, geokodad samma väg (score 100).

facilities.name: Brookings Public Library
facilities.description: The city's public library, located one block east of downtown and adjacent to the Children's Museum of South Dakota. Offers books, DVDs, audiobooks, board games, video games, maker kits, and a full calendar of community programs. Open roughly 66 hours a week.

facilities.name: Brookings City Hall (City & County Government Center)
facilities.description: Houses the City Clerk's Office, City Manager's Office, Community Development, Engineering, Finance, Human Resources, and Parks & Recreation departments. Shares the building with Brookings County offices; City Council and County Commission meetings are held in the third-floor chambers.

facilities.name: Dakota Nature Park
facilities.address: 22nd Ave S and 32nd St S, Brookings, SD 57006
facilities.description: A 135-acre park on a former landfill site, restored into trails, ponds, and wildlife habitat. Open for fishing, canoeing/kayaking, hiking, biking, bird-watching, and — in winter — snowshoeing and cross-country skiing. Includes the Larson Nature Center, run by the Brookings Parks, Recreation & Forestry Department.

facilities.name: Dana J. Dykhouse Stadium
facilities.description: SDSU's football stadium, opened 2016, capacity 19,340. Home of the Jackrabbits football team.

facilities.name: First Bank & Trust Arena
facilities.description: SDSU's basketball, volleyball and wrestling arena, capacity 5,000, opened fall 2024.

facilities.name: Oscar Larson Performing Arts Center
facilities.description: SDSU's home stage for music, theatre and dance.

facilities.name: Hilton M. Briggs Library
facilities.description: SDSU's main library -- roughly 680,000 bound volumes, 1 million microforms, and over 600,000 government documents, plus electronic journal access. Distinct from the city's public library.

facilities.name: McCrory Gardens
facilities.description: SDSU's public garden and arboretum -- part of the South Dakota Arboretum.

facilities.name: Brookings County Outdoor Adventure Center
facilities.description: A city-run outdoor recreation facility offering equipment rentals and programs for hiking, paddling, and other outdoor activities.

facilities.name: Downtown Brookings — Main Avenue
facilities.description: Brookings' downtown commercial district along Main Avenue -- home to the recurring "Downtown at Sundown" event series and other street-level community events. No single street address: events here happen at various points along Main Avenue, not one fixed building.

facilities.name: Edgebrook Golf Course
facilities.description: The city's public 18-hole golf course, on the north side of town.

facilities.name: Good Roots Farm and Gardens
facilities.description: A local farm on the north side of Brookings that hosts community events and gatherings.

facilities.name: Wooden Legs Brewing Company
facilities.description: A local brewery and taproom that hosts recurring community events (trivia nights, live music).
